description: Day 2 mini evaluation set (18 questions). Types required by the brief: direct, paraphrased, abbreviation, threshold, out-of-scope.

questions.query: What are the core diagnostic symptoms of major depressive disorder?
questions.reason: DSM/ICD diagnostic criteria for depression live in NICE CG91 appendix, NG222, and NG134 context.

questions.query: What treatment options are effective for depression, including medication and therapy?
questions.reason: WHO factsheet and NICE NG222 list antidepressants and psychological therapy.

questions.query: How is depression severity measured or screened in clinical settings?
questions.reason: USPSTF screening tests and NICE severity categories.

questions.query: What signs mean an adult has clinical depression rather than ordinary sadness?
questions.reason: Paraphrase of diagnostic duration and core symptoms.

questions.query: What should a clinician try next if antidepressant tablets alone are not helping?
questions.reason: NG222 further-line treatment after limited antidepressant response.

questions.query: How do clinicians decide whether depression is mild, moderate or severe?
questions.reason: NICE severity continuum and ICD-10 categories.

questions.query: What is PHQ-9 used for in depression care?
questions.reason: Abbreviation for Patient Health Questionnaire-9 screening tool.

questions.query: When should SSRIs be offered for depression in adults?
questions.reason: SSRI is an exact drug-class term; keyword/hybrid should help.

questions.query: What does MDD mean and how is it diagnosed?
questions.reason: MDD abbreviation used heavily in USPSTF statements.

questions.query: What does NICE NG222 recommend for treating depression in adults?
questions.reason: Guideline ID should retrieve the NG222 PDF.

questions.query: How long must depressive symptoms last before depression can be diagnosed?
questions.reason: Diagnostic duration threshold of two weeks.

questions.query: How many DSM-5 symptoms are required for a diagnosis of major depression?
After starting treatment for depression, when should the clinician review how well it is working?
For how many years must symptoms persist to be called chronic depressive symptoms in NICE NG222?
What insulin dose should be started in a newly diagnosed adult with type 1 diabetes?
questions.reason: No diabetes insulin guidance in this corpus. All hits should be not relevant.

questions.query: How should community-acquired pneumonia be treated in adults?
questions.reason: Respiratory infection is outside the depression knowledge base.

questions.query: What are the NICE criteria for starting a statin for primary prevention of CVD?
questions.reason: Cardiovascular prevention is not in the indexed PDFs.

questions.query: What is the surgical management of acute appendicitis?
questions.reason: Surgical topic; used as a documented retrieval failure case.
